_comment: Ordered training phases + counter anchors for Hevy routine titles (Phase - Type - N - Y), consumed by routine_title.build_title_context. Manually advanced by Matthew — no auto/milestone-driven transitions. `current` is the active phase; flip it to advance and bump `current_started` to that date (this resets N per type). `current_started` = phase_started_date: N counts PERFORMED workouts of each type on/after it. `reset_epoch_date` = the experiment-reset anchor: Y counts PERFORMED workouts on/after it. Both are inclusive (>=). See ADR-067 (superseded by the 2026-06-16 work order).
_reset_epoch_note: Hand re-anchored 2026-09-06 to the cycle-17 genesis (EXPERIMENT_START_DATE). This file is NOT touched by deploy/restart_pipeline.py, so `reset_epoch_date` had survived eleven resets at 2026-06-16 and the Y counter was cycle-blind (day 1 of the block rendered `Foundation - Push - 3 - 11`). #3671 owns the durable fix: derive the anchor from EXPERIMENT_START_DATE, or give the reset ownership of the config anchors ADR-077 does not reach. `current`/`current_started` are DELIBERATELY unchanged — the phase advances only when Matthew says so, and only the experiment counter Y zeroes on a reset.
